# E38 — interaction apparatus disposition

Date: 2026-08-23

Status: apparatus nonqualification; original interaction route closed; no GPU
successor authorized

Standalone repository and final result:
[qwen38-system-interaction-persistence-scout-v0@362868a](https://github.com/ScrappyTom/qwen38-system-interaction-persistence-scout-v0/commit/362868ae25a7301a9fe34a90e59768318537c852)

## Intended system interaction

The planned scout crossed two persistence channels at the authentic first
Ceiba pressure boundary:

```text
source-bound semantic residue
×
cumulative task-native evidence-integration work
```

Exact custody, deterministic first-fit relief, reopen, actor actions, effects,
checks, resumption, and external readiness evaluation were common. The unit
was intended to be each complete A/B/C/D trajectory, not a component output.

Before actor measurement, four representative maintenance shapes had to
qualify: residue bootstrap, residue replacement, work bootstrap, and joint-state
work replacement. The gate was apparatus only.

## Three-gate sequence

All twelve calls used one attempt and zero retries. Together they consumed
84,612 serialized tokens. No maintenance output entered an ordinary actor
trajectory.

| Gate | Accepted | Main finding |
|---|---:|---|
| v0 | 1/4 | Plain text alone did not enforce boundedness; work outputs also referenced unseen source IDs and expanded toward the final charter. |
| v1 | 2/4 | Mechanical source allowlists and an evidence-integration discriminator fixed provenance and artifact type; both existing-state replacements passed, both cold starts failed. |
| v2 | 3/4 | Empty work scaffolding qualified work bootstrap and update; the first source residue still produced 310 tokens against the unchanged 256-token limit. |

Every v2 output stopped naturally and remained within its source allowlist.
Both work outputs satisfied the task-native intermediate-artifact rules at 655
and 734 tokens. The prior-residue update passed at 190 tokens. The only final
failure was the 310-token first residue.

## Supported interpretation

The dedicated per-demotion 256-token source-residue interface did not qualify
reliable bootstrap under this task/model/runtime. The larger task-native
evidence-integration carrier qualified its two representative expression
shapes, but its downstream utility remains untested.

This is not evidence that semantic persistence is useless, that 310 tokens is
always uneconomic, or that cumulative work improves task performance. It is
evidence that the declared A/B/C/D comparison cannot be run faithfully through
its frozen transport.

## Prospective stopping rule

V2 was declared final before inference. Therefore:

- no v3 prompt, seed, cap, scaffold, or format variant;
- no host truncation or silent semantic repair;
- no post-hoc increase from 256 to 310 tokens;
- no measured A/B/C/D run; and
- no salvage comparison using only A and C under the old name.

The route is closed rather than optimized indefinitely.

## Failure migration and remaining system question

E36 showed an authentic different bottleneck:

```text
exact evidence can keep entering
        ↓
one bounded read consumes one actor decision
        ↓
old evidence becomes identity-only receipts
        ↓
no cumulative task-native work forms
        ↓
call budget ends before construction
```

E38 adds that per-source tiny semantic maintenance is not a qualified transport,
while task-native cumulative work expression is mechanically viable in the two
final shapes tested.

The next candidate interaction is therefore:

```text
evidence-ingress bandwidth
×
cumulative task-native work externalization
```

A candidate four-configuration terrain scout would compare one-range versus
bounded multi-range acquisition and whole-final-artifact-only versus bounded
evidence-integration work. These are whole feedback systems: ingress affects
result size, pressure, and call budget; work affects residency, later demand,
construction, and anchoring risk.

## Stage 0 obligations for a successor

Before another GPU request:

1. qualify a bounded multi-range action without treatment-only evidence or
   hidden semantic repair;
2. freeze whether work production shares an actor response or consumes a
   separately charged call;
3. enforce exact evidence-source admission for work;
4. distinguish intermediate work from the final candidate mechanically;
5. prove a feasible horizon through acquisition, construction, effect uptake,
   checking, repair, and closure; and
6. retain the complete trajectory and downstream artifact/readiness outcome as
   the primary unit.

## System question

At the exact E36 result-delivery pressure boundary, how do two interacting
functions change the complete bounded-work trajectory?

```text
actor-selected evidence-ingress bandwidth
×
bounded cumulative task-native work
```

The four configurations cross one exact range versus a bounded actor-selected
batch of one to three ranges with whole-final-artifact-only versus a bounded
replacement evidence-integration record. All four retain the same exact world,
custody, first-fit relief, reopen, actor model and budget, action/effect loop,
candidate-bound checking, reactive capacity reentry, and independent readiness
evaluation.

This is not relief versus context death and not a set of component tests. The
unit is the whole trajectory through acquisition, pressure, persistent work,
construction, effect uptake, verification, repair, and closure or declared
budget exhaustion.

## Offline findings

- Authentic ordinary packet: 21,442 prompt tokens against 20,992 allowed.
- Common first-fit packet: 19,818 tokens after externalizing `RESULT-001`.
- I1/I2 first actor packets: 20,481 / 20,529 tokens.
- Maximum-size I3/I4 work packets initially overflow; first-fit externalizes
  `RESULT-002`, yielding 13,984 / 14,032 tokens.
- Because work is triggered by exact-body externalization, I3/I4 owe two work
  updates before actor call one: `RESULT-001`, then `RESULT-002`.
- Work bootstrap and representative large-batch update prompts remain within
  the 25,088-token provider context including their completion ceilings.
- A synthetic late reactive-reentry packet fits at 19,221 tokens.
- Runtime tests: 21/21. Inherited evaluator tests: 5/5.
- The inherited evaluation law is rebound to this experiment's exact task lock.

The treatment-induced second demotion is intentionally preserved. It is the
real residency and maintenance cost of carrying cumulative work under pressure,
not an imbalance to erase.

## Live apparatus result

The new batch action passed both prospectively frozen live fixtures:

1. one requested range;
2. three requested ranges.

Run `2026-08-23-ingress-action-expression-qualification-v0` used two model
calls, one attempt per call, and zero retries. Both responses were valid bounded
`read_batch` actions, both stopped normally, and both exact results executed
below the 12,000-token batch-result gate. The run consumed 40,676 serialized
tokens: Q01 used 20,268 prompt and 31 completion tokens; Q02 used 20,307 prompt
and 70 completion tokens. The exact run is sealed in the standalone result
commit.

This is action-transport qualification only. It supplies no evidence that batch
ingress, cumulative work, or their interaction improves a trajectory.
